_note: THE BOARD (2026-10-19, late): the Intake sheet's object, four scenes turning by themselves like a departures board (src/components/IntakeBoard.astro). Each scene: the LINE (the circumstance, set as split-flap cells), what he sent on the left, the Intake card it became on the right (a month cell beside the two dated ones). An EXHIBIT, not a record: scenes 1 to 3 are captures 50, 49 and 53 of the M1's intake.db (their images in public/intake/board/, the save-the-date's names blurred); Theo & June and Lena are invented. ⚠️ EVERY sentence here is a DRAFT in Jon's voice, his to rewrite (the `say` lines are the live region's). The card fields follow intake_web.py's Stream: a receipt wears the green check and its compact line, an open card its kind chip, and an age in days that goes `old` (the lamp's colour) at 7.
